requirements.quote:
kLossReductionFactor:  Scaling factor applied to reduce the
      congestion window when a new loss event is detected.  Section 7
      recommends a value of 0.5.
requirements.condition: When selecting the loss-reduction scaling factor for this congestion controller
requirements.required_behavior: Use 0.5 as the recommended value of kLossReductionFactor.
requirements.why_checkable: The configured constant can be compared directly with the stated numeric recommendation.

requirements.quote:
kPersistentCongestionThreshold:  Period of time for persistent
      congestion to be established, specified as a PTO multiplier.
      Section 7.6 recommends a value of 3.
requirements.condition: When selecting the PTO multiplier used to establish persistent congestion
requirements.required_behavior: Use 3 as the recommended value of kPersistentCongestionThreshold.
requirements.why_checkable: The configured multiplier can be compared directly with the stated numeric recommendation.

requirements.quote:
max_datagram_size:  The sender's current maximum payload size.  This
      does not include UDP or IP overhead.
requirements.condition: When representing max_datagram_size
requirements.required_behavior: Represent the sender's current maximum payload size without UDP or IP overhead.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Including UDP or IP overhead in max_datagram_size.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet-size accounting can verify which protocol-layer bytes contribute to the variable.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint sets the
      value of this variable based on its Path Maximum Transmission Unit
      (PMTU; see Section 14.2 of [QUIC-TRANSPORT]), with a minimum value
      of 1200 bytes.
requirements.condition: When setting max_datagram_size
requirements.required_behavior: Base max_datagram_size on the endpoint's Path Maximum Transmission Unit.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Setting max_datagram_size independently of the applicable PMTU.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can vary the PMTU input and inspect the resulting maximum datagram size.

requirements.quote:
An endpoint sets the
      value of this variable based on its Path Maximum Transmission Unit
      (PMTU; see Section 14.2 of [QUIC-TRANSPORT]), with a minimum value
      of 1200 bytes.
requirements.condition: Whenever max_datagram_size is set
requirements.required_behavior: Keep max_datagram_size at or above 1200 bytes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Setting max_datagram_size below 1200 bytes.
requirements.why_checkable: The variable has an explicit numeric lower bound.

requirements.quote:
ecn_ce_counters[kPacketNumberSpace]:  The highest value reported for
      the ECN-CE counter in the packet number space by the peer in an
      ACK frame.
requirements.condition: For each packet number space after processing peer ACK ECN information
requirements.required_behavior: Store the highest peer-reported ECN-CE counter value for that packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Replacing the stored value with a lower reported ECN-CE counter.
requirements.why_checkable: Sequences of ACK frames can verify that the per-space stored counter is the maximum observed value.

requirements.quote:
bytes_in_flight:  The sum of the size in bytes of all sent packets
      that contain at least one ack-eliciting or PADDING frame and have
      not been acknowledged or declared lost.
requirements.condition: When computing bytes_in_flight
requirements.required_behavior: Sum sent packets that contain at least one ack-eliciting or PADDING frame and are neither acknowledged nor declared lost.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Counting packets outside that membership rule or retaining packets after acknowledgment or loss declaration.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet ledger with controlled frame types and acknowledgment/loss states determines the exact expected sum.

requirements.quote:
The size does not include
      IP or UDP overhead
requirements.condition: When adding a packet's size to bytes_in_flight
requirements.required_behavior: Exclude IP and UDP overhead.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Including IP or UDP overhead in bytes_in_flight.
requirements.why_checkable: Expected accounting can be calculated from a packet with known transport and network overhead.

requirements.quote:
but does include the QUIC header and
      Authenticated Encryption with Associated Data (AEAD) overhead.
requirements.condition: When adding a packet's size to bytes_in_flight
requirements.required_behavior: Include the QUIC header and AEAD overhead.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Excluding the QUIC header or AEAD overhead from bytes_in_flight.
requirements.why_checkable: Expected accounting can include known header and encryption overhead and be compared with state.

requirements.quote:
Packets only containing ACK frames do not count toward
      bytes_in_flight
requirements.condition: When a sent packet contains only ACK frames
requirements.required_behavior: Do not add the packet to bytes_in_flight.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Counting an ACK-only packet toward bytes_in_flight.
requirements.why_checkable: Sending an ACK-only packet exposes whether bytes_in_flight changes.

requirements.quote: congestion_window:  Maximum number of bytes allowed to be in flight.
requirements.condition: When congestion control authorizes ordinary in-flight data
requirements.required_behavior: Use congestion_window as the maximum number of bytes allowed in flight.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Authorizing ordinary bytes in flight beyond congestion_window.
requirements.why_checkable: The sender's authorization decision can be tested at and above the stored byte limit.

requirements.quote:
When a packet sent
      after this time is acknowledged, QUIC exits congestion recovery.
requirements.condition: When a packet sent after congestion_recovery_start_time is acknowledged
requirements.required_behavior: Exit congestion recovery.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Remaining in congestion recovery after such an acknowledgment.
requirements.why_checkable: Packet send and acknowledgment times can be controlled around the recovery start timestamp.

requirements.quote:
When the congestion window
      is below ssthresh, the mode is slow start
requirements.condition: When congestion_window is below ssthresh
requirements.required_behavior: Operate in slow-start mode.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Operating in congestion-avoidance mode while congestion_window is below ssthresh.
requirements.why_checkable: The mode selection follows an explicit comparison of two observable variables.

requirements.quote:
the window grows by
      the number of bytes acknowledged.
requirements.condition: When an eligible acknowledgment is processed in slow start
requirements.required_behavior: Increase congestion_window by the number of bytes acknowledged.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Applying the congestion-avoidance growth formula in slow start.
requirements.why_checkable: The pre- and post-acknowledgment congestion windows can be compared against acknowledged bytes.

requirements.quote: congestion_window = kInitialWindow
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize congestion_window to kInitialWindow.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Initializing congestion_window to a different value.
requirements.why_checkable: Initial connection state exposes the assigned value directly.

requirements.quote: bytes_in_flight = 0
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize bytes_in_flight to zero.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Initializing bytes_in_flight to a nonzero value.
requirements.why_checkable: Initial connection state exposes the assigned value directly.

requirements.quote: congestion_recovery_start_time = 0
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize congestion_recovery_start_time to zero.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Initializing congestion_recovery_start_time to a nonzero value.
requirements.why_checkable: Initial connection state exposes the assigned value directly.

requirements.quote: ssthresh = infinite
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize ssthresh to infinity.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Initializing ssthresh to a finite threshold.
requirements.why_checkable: Initial connection state or its effective threshold semantics can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
for pn_space in [ Initial, Handshake, ApplicationData ]:
     ecn_ce_counters[pn_space] = 0
requirements.condition: At the beginning of a connection
requirements.required_behavior: Initialize each of the Initial, Handshake, and ApplicationData ECN-CE counters to zero.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leaving any listed packet-number-space counter uninitialized or nonzero.
requirements.why_checkable: All three initial per-space counter values can be inspected.

requirements.quote:
Whenever a packet is sent and it contains non-ACK frames, the packet
   increases bytes_in_flight.

   OnPacketSentCC(sent_bytes):
     bytes_in_flight += sent_bytes
requirements.condition: Whenever a sent packet contains a non-ACK frame
requirements.required_behavior: Increase bytes_in_flight by sent_bytes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leaving bytes_in_flight unchanged for a qualifying sent packet.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled packet send provides a known sent_bytes delta for the counter.

requirements.quote:
In congestion avoidance, implementers that use an integer
   representation for congestion_window should be careful with division
   and can use the alternative approach suggested in Section 2.1 of
   [RFC3465].
requirements.condition: When congestion_window uses an integer representation in congestion avoidance
requirements.required_behavior: Be careful with division or optionally use the referenced alternative approach.
requirements.why_checkable: The text gives no numerical correctness criterion for being careful and makes the alternative optional.

requirements.quote:
InCongestionRecovery(sent_time):
     return sent_time <= congestion_recovery_start_time
requirements.condition: When testing whether a packet was sent in the current recovery period
requirements.required_behavior: Return true exactly when sent_time is less than or equal to congestion_recovery_start_time.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Treating a packet sent after congestion_recovery_start_time as being in recovery.
requirements.why_checkable: Boundary timestamps before, equal to, and after the start time fully test the predicate.

requirements.condition: When OnPacketsAcked receives a collection of newly acknowledged packets
requirements.required_behavior: Call OnPacketAcked once for every packet in acked_packets.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Skipping or processing only a subset of the acknowledged packets.
requirements.why_checkable: A multi-packet input can verify one callback and state update per element.

requirements.quote:
if (!acked_packet.in_flight):
       return;
requirements.condition: When an acknowledged packet was not marked in flight
requirements.required_behavior: Return without applying congestion-control acknowledgment updates.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Changing bytes_in_flight or congestion_window for that packet.
requirements.why_checkable: State can be compared before and after acknowledging a packet with in_flight false.

requirements.quote: bytes_in_flight -= acked_packet.sent_bytes
requirements.condition: When an acknowledged packet was in flight
requirements.required_behavior: Subtract acked_packet.sent_bytes from bytes_in_flight.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Retaining the acknowledged packet's bytes in bytes_in_flight.
requirements.why_checkable: The exact post-acknowledgment counter is determined by the prior value and sent_bytes.

requirements.condition: When the sender is application-limited or flow-control-limited while processing an acknowledgment
requirements.required_behavior: Return without increasing congestion_window.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Increasing congestion_window for that acknowledgment.
requirements.why_checkable: A test can force each limited state and compare congestion_window before and after acknowledgment.

requirements.condition: When the acknowledged packet was sent during the recovery period
requirements.required_behavior: Return without increasing congestion_window.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Increasing congestion_window for that acknowledgment.
requirements.why_checkable: A packet timestamp within recovery provides a deterministic no-growth case.

requirements.condition: When processing an eligible in-flight acknowledgment and congestion_window is below ssthresh
requirements.required_behavior: Increase congestion_window by acked_packet.sent_bytes.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using the congestion-avoidance increment in this branch.
requirements.why_checkable: Known initial window, threshold, and packet size determine the exact new window.

requirements.condition: When processing an eligible in-flight acknowledgment and congestion_window is not below ssthresh
requirements.required_behavior: Increase congestion_window by max_datagram_size multiplied by acked_packet.sent_bytes and divided by the current congestion_window.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Applying the slow-start increment in the congestion-avoidance branch.
requirements.why_checkable: Known operand values determine the expected congestion-window increment.

requirements.quote:
This is invoked from ProcessECN and OnPacketsLost when a new
   congestion event is detected.
requirements.condition: When ProcessECN or OnPacketsLost detects a new congestion event
requirements.required_behavior: Invoke OnCongestionEvent for the event.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Failing to route a newly detected ECN or loss congestion event through OnCongestionEvent.
requirements.why_checkable: Instrumented ECN and loss paths can verify invocation of the common event handler.

requirements.condition: When a congestion event's sent_time is already within the recovery period
requirements.required_behavior: Return without reacting to the event.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Restarting recovery or reducing ssthresh or congestion_window for the event.
requirements.why_checkable: Repeated events with timestamps inside the same recovery period can verify all congestion state remains unchanged.

requirements.quote: congestion_recovery_start_time = now()
requirements.condition: When handling a new congestion event outside recovery
requirements.required_behavior: Set congestion_recovery_start_time to the current time.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leaving the recovery start time unchanged.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled clock permits direct comparison with the assigned recovery timestamp.

requirements.quote: ssthresh = congestion_window * kLossReductionFactor
requirements.condition: When handling a new congestion event outside recovery
requirements.required_behavior: Set ssthresh to the pre-reduction congestion_window multiplied by kLossReductionFactor.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Computing ssthresh from an unrelated window or factor.
requirements.why_checkable: Known pre-event window and factor determine the exact threshold.

requirements.quote: congestion_window = max(ssthresh, kMinimumWindow)
requirements.condition: After computing ssthresh for a new congestion event outside recovery
requirements.required_behavior: Set congestion_window to the greater of ssthresh and kMinimumWindow.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Reducing congestion_window below kMinimumWindow or leaving it above ssthresh when ssthresh is the greater value.
requirements.why_checkable: Inputs on both sides of the minimum-window boundary determine the exact expected result.

requirements.quote:
// A packet can be sent to speed up loss recovery.
     MaybeSendOnePacket()
requirements.condition: After entering a new recovery period
requirements.required_behavior: Optionally send one packet to speed loss recovery.
requirements.why_checkable: The prose grants permission rather than imposing a required observable behavior, despite the example call.

requirements.quote:
This is invoked when an ACK frame with an ECN section is received
   from the peer.
requirements.condition: When a peer ACK frame containing an ECN section is received
requirements.required_behavior: Invoke ProcessECN with the ACK and its packet number space.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Ignoring the ECN section without invoking ECN processing.
requirements.why_checkable: Receiving an ACK with ECN information can be instrumented to verify the processing callback.

requirements.quote:
if (ack.ce_counter > ecn_ce_counters[pn_space]):
       ecn_ce_counters[pn_space] = ack.ce_counter
requirements.condition: When an ACK's ECN-CE counter exceeds the stored counter for its packet number space
requirements.required_behavior: Update that packet number space's stored ECN-CE counter to ack.ce_counter.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Leaving the stored counter at the older lower value.
requirements.why_checkable: A higher reported counter has a precisely defined resulting stored value.

requirements.quote: sent_time = sent_packets[ack.largest_acked].time_sent
requirements.condition: After detecting an increased ECN-CE counter
requirements.required_behavior: Obtain sent_time from the sent-packet record indexed by ack.largest_acked.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Using another packet's send time for the ECN congestion event.
requirements.why_checkable: Distinct packet send times make the selected record observable.

requirements.quote: OnCongestionEvent(sent_time)
requirements.condition: After an increased ECN-CE counter is stored and sent_time is obtained
requirements.required_behavior: Invoke OnCongestionEvent with that sent_time.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Failing to signal the possible new congestion event or passing a different timestamp.
requirements.why_checkable: The event handler argument and resulting recovery state can be observed.

requirements.quote: if (ack.ce_counter > ecn_ce_counters[pn_space]):
requirements.condition: When an ACK's ECN-CE counter does not exceed the stored counter for its packet number space
requirements.required_behavior: Do not update the counter or invoke OnCongestionEvent through this branch.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Treating an equal or lower ECN-CE counter as a new congestion event.
requirements.why_checkable: The strict greater-than guard directly implies no branch actions for equal or lower values.

requirements.quote: This is invoked when DetectAndRemoveLostPackets deems packets lost.
requirements.condition: When DetectAndRemoveLostPackets deems packets lost
requirements.required_behavior: Invoke the OnPacketsLost handling path.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Failing to pass the detected losses to OnPacketsLost.
requirements.why_checkable: A controlled loss-detection outcome can verify invocation of the named loss-handling hook.
